snippet.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Complete Edition | Next-Gen Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Relive the story loved by millions!

Free next-gen update for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is coming to PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series S|X on December 14th, 2022! Experience the game as never before, with improved visuals and performance, new additional content, Photo Mode, and more...

For more information about The Witcher visit:
http://thewitcher.com/witcher3  
https://www.fb.com/thewitcher
